import_rules: Retain all concept-to-FJ relationships; determine leaf identity from OBJ header or separately verified primary mapping.
COMPOUND concepts reuse ELEMENT members; do not count compound membership rows as individual meshes.
A one-member relationship alone cannot prove leaf identity when its OBJ header has not been inspected.
Preserve M suffixes and separate bilateral and mirrored provenance; do not infer observation from a suffix.

sources.status: exact assets and attribution-only license scope unresolved
sources.version_rules: Decimal updates add/replace OBJ parts; integer changes concern coordinates. 4.3i adds inferred part-of relations; 3899 is a concept count, not a mesh count.
sources.coordinates: not verified for exact candidate assets
sources.specimen: Do not assume unchanged Release 4.0 tissue provenance for replaced parts.

third_party_lead.status: delegated source-audit lead; not acquired or authoritative
third_party_lead.import_hazard: First containing FMA concept is not necessarily the leaf (e.g. brachialis group FMA37348 versus leaf FMA37668). CSV rows are not unique tissue counts.

evidence_policy: Related ontology concepts, archive-member availability, locally verified source surfaces, observed segmentations and authored geometry remain separate.
Do not invent missing tissue geometry, attachment coordinates or source identifiers.
Do not combine specimens into one observed anatomy.
Offline audits never download. Acquisition is an explicit bounded command with pinned bytes, license attribution and receipts.
A source comparison is not clinical validation or a simulation readiness certificate.
